description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class for managing custom shipping methods, including CRUD operations for regions and prices, configuration handling, and related shipping logic within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: CustomShippingMethodsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling CRUD and configuration operations for custom shipping methods, specifically weight-based regions and pricing, within a modular e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the weight-based shipping configuration page.

methods.name: addCustomRegion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new shipping region in the custom shipping configuration.

methods.name: addCountryToCustomRegion
methods.description: Adds a country to a specified shipping region.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Saves the shipping configuration, including modules and custom settings.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Removes a country from a region asynchronously and returns JSON response.

methods.name: deletePrice
methods.description: Removes a price weight item from a region asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Deletes the entire weight-based custom shipping module configuration.

methods.name: checkRegionCode
methods.description: Checks if a region code already exists to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: pageCustomShipping
methods.description: Returns paginated data of region codes and names for display.

methods.name: editCustomShipping
methods.description: Retrieves a specific region's details for editing.

methods.name: pageCustomShippingDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed weight and price info for a particular shipping region.

methods.name: addPrice
methods.description: Adds a weight-based price quote to a shipping region.

methods.name: deleteRegion
methods.description: Removes an entire shipping region and its associated data.

methods.name: populateModel
methods.description: Internal method to prepare shipping configuration data for views.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Internal method to set the menu highlighting in views.
